description_zh: 上传用户的自定义Windows镜像
kebab_example: aliyun ecd upload-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --oss-object-path https://ossbucket:endpoint/object --image-name Win10_Test --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadImage

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS object path of the image file
parameters.name: oss_object_path

parameters.help_en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的描述信息。长度为2\~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the image is a GPU-type image
parameters.name: gpu_category

parameters.help_en: The data cloud disk size. Valid values: 80 to 500. Unit: GiB
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘大小，取值范围：80~500。单位：GiB
parameters.name: data_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The type of the pre-installed GPU driver
parameters.name: gpu_driver_type

parameters.help_en:
The license type used to activate the operating system after the image is imported. Valid values:

Auto: Alibaba Cloud detects the source operating system and assigns a license. In automatic mode, the system first checks whether an Alibaba Cloud official license is available for the `Platform` you specified and assigns it to the imported image. If no such license is available, the system switches to BYOL (Bring Your Own License) mode.
Aliyun: Uses an Alibaba Cloud official license based on the `Platform` you specified.
BYOL: Uses the license that comes with the source operating system. When using BYOL, ensure that your license key supports use on Alibaba Cloud.

Default value: Auto

Systems such as Windows 10 cannot be activated through Alibaba Cloud. Set `LicenseType` to custom activation (BYOL)
parameters.help_zh:
导入镜像后，激活操作系统采用的许可证类型。取值范围：

Auto：由阿里云检测源操作系统并分配许可证。自动模式下，系统优先搜索您设置的`Platform`是否有阿里云官方渠道的许可证并分配给导入的镜像，如果缺乏该类许可，会切换成BYOL（Bring Your Own License）方式。
Aliyun：根据您设置的`Platform`采用阿里云官方渠道的许可证。
BYOL：源操作系统自带的许可证。采用BYOL时，您必须确保您的许可证密钥支持在阿里云使用。

默认值：Auto

Windows 10等系统无法通过阿里云激活，请将`LicenseType`设为自定义激活（BYOL）
parameters.name: license_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable security check
parameters.name: enable_security_check

parameters.help_en:
The system cloud disk size. Unit: GiB.

The system cloud disk size cannot be smaller than the image file
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘大小，单位：GiB。

系统盘大小不能小于镜像文件
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The boot mode of the image
parameters.name: boot_mode
